summary: Sandbach United's Macron Cup run came to an end in the first round on September 26th when they fell to local rivals Alsager Town on penalties after a goalless 90 minutes. Despite some late chances, including a shot from Foley that struck the post, the Blues couldn't find a breakthrough in regulation time. Joe Bevan continues to lead the goalscoring charts across the NWCFL with 135 goals this season.
